newsitem.title: CANADA: Philip buying RMF, Intsel partnership.
newsitem.headline: Philip buying RMF, Intsel partnership.

text.p: Philip Environmental Inc said on Monday it agreed in separate deals to acquire Intsel Southwest Ltd Partnership from Pechiney Inc and Toledo, Ohio-based RMF Global Inc.

Philip said the acquisition of Intsel, a leading distributor of a broad line of heavy carbon steel products which generates annual revenue in excess of US$130 million, is expected to occur by December 31, 1996, Philip said.
The acquisition of RMF, an industrial maintenance provider with annual revenue in excess of US$62 million, is expected to occur by January 15, 1996, Philip said.
Intsel, with a primary distribution and processing facility is located in Houston, Texas, is one of the largest distributors of structural steel products in the southern United States, Philip said.
"Intsel has experienced record growth in revenue and tonnage shipped over the past three years," Philip President and Chief Executive Allen Fracassi said.

Philip said RMF will broaden the capability of Philip's environmental services group to deliver a broad range of on-site industrial services including fabrication, installation, monitoring, cleaning and maintenance.
